Manifest.Name: 可能是按键统一优化 / Probably Unified Hotkeys
Manifest.Author: 太湖白1231
Manifest.Description:
将原版与所有模组的快捷键与常规设置统一整合进官方 ESC「选项」页，并全面重构「选项 / 全部展开 / 改造件 / 退出游戏」四大核心交互流畅度。
【能做什么】 • 统一整理：上方原版分区与下方模组卡片均支持折叠、拼音搜索与展开一键「恢复默认」 • 按键增强：支持 Shift / Ctrl / Alt 组合键、鼠标组合/侧键，按 Esc 即可解绑为「无」 • 搜索排重：支持简繁中文、英文与拼音搜索定位，自带 [!] 仅看冲突集中排查与防误触 • 丝滑响应：离线窗口装配、按帧预算预建、改造件列表对象池复用及全模组极速秒退优化 • 模组排查：支持排查未通过官方配置暴露隐藏按键的模组，强制提权可疑项并一键跳转至对应卡片 • 双语切换：支持简体中文 / English 实时切换（默认跟随游戏语言），可在改造件齿轮设置或本模组卡片中调整
【怎么使用】 按 ESC 打开「选项」→ 顶部搜索或展开/收起任意分区卡片 → 点击按键直接录入（按 Esc 清空，左/右键取消）→ 点击底部「应用设置」保存生效。
---
Unifies vanilla and mod hotkeys & settings into the official ESC "Options" menu, while overhauling responsiveness across Options, Expand All, Mods, and Quit Game.
[Features] • Unified View: Collapsible vanilla & mod cards with CN/EN/Pinyin search and per-card "Reset" • Enhanced Keybinds: Supports Shift / Ctrl / Alt combos, mouse & side buttons, and Esc to unbind to "None" • Conflict Check & Filter: Supports CN (Simp/Trad), EN & Pinyin search, "[!] Conflicts" view, and anti-leak combo guard • Smooth Performance: Off-screen batched window assembly, frame-budgeted prebuild, pooled Mods list, and fast quit • Mod Diagnostics: Inspect mods without official config exposure, promote candidate entries, and jump directly to cards • Bilingual UI: Supports Simplified Chinese / English live switching (defaults to Follow Game Language) via the Mods gear settings or this mod's card
[How to Use] Press ESC → "Options" → search or expand/collapse cards → click any keybind to capture (Esc to clear, Left/Right click to cancel) → click "Apply" at the bottom.
